name: Scarlet Raven Tavern
summary: In Darkshire, the Scarlet Raven Tavern is the town’s primary inn and social center. Tavernkeep Smitts welcomes beleaguered locals, passing adventurers, and frightened travelers seeking shelter from the horrors beyond town.

sections.title: A Dim Refuge
sections.body: At the Scarlet Raven Tavern, the hearth burns in the heart of Darkshire as eternal dusk hangs over the forest. Years ago, it was a busy stop where Marshal Haggard and the Stormwind Guard shared pints after patrols. Since then, business has withered alongside the town’s security. Tavernkeep Smitts tends the bar for a somber, anxious crowd huddled against cold and fear. The inn remains a crossroads for rumors and a starting point for travelers seeking answers to the dark phenomena consuming the region.

sections.title: Secrets and Stolen Pints
sections.body: Jitters, a reclusive wanderer, rented a room at the Scarlet Raven for days and filled his journal with frantic notes by night before fleeing town ahead of the Dark Riders. Decades-old gossip and preserved guest records kept beneath the tavern also connect to long-forgotten figures such as Stalvan Mistmantle. Investigators tracing the histories of Duskwood’s restless dead begin their search in Smitts’ taproom.

faq.q: Who runs the Scarlet Raven Tavern?
faq.answer: Tavernkeep Smitts runs the Scarlet Raven Tavern. An innkeeper and other staff also serve travelers in Darkshire.

faq.q: Why is the tavern's atmosphere so gloomy?
faq.answer: The curse over Duskwood has choked trade routes and terrified the locals. Undead, feral worgen, and shadowy riders prowl the woods outside town, while the tavern crowd is made up of frightened townsfolk and desperate mercenaries rather than carefree travelers.

faq.q: Did Jitters stay at the Scarlet Raven?
faq.answer: Jitters stayed at the Scarlet Raven Tavern and wrote frantically in his journal before fleeing town. His reasons emerge through the investigation into Duskwood.

faq.q: What connection does this tavern have to the Legend of Stalvan?
faq.answer: Old patrons and town records preserved in and around the tavern hold clues about Stalvan Mistmantle. He once frequented the settlement before falling into tragedy and infamy.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers crossing the southern border, the Scarlet Raven offers one of the few safe hearths and rest stops between Elwynn Forest and Deadwind Pass.
The inn serves regional delicacies such as Dusky Crab Cakes, a local staple that desperate wanderers like Jitters crave even while hiding in the graveyard.
